verse.verse_1: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
verse.verse_2: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."
verse.verse_3: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
verse.verse_4: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),
verse.verse_5: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
verse.verse_6: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,
verse.verse_7: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
verse.verse_8: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.
verse.verse_9: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their messenger): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.
verse.verse_10: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
verse.verse_11: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.
verse.verse_12: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.
verse.verse_13: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm-fibre:
verse.verse_14: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!
verse.verse_15: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?
verse.verse_16: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?
verse.verse_17: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
verse.verse_18: The 'Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?
verse.verse_19: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,
verse.verse_20: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).
verse.verse_21: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
verse.verse_22: But We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
verse.verse_24: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!
verse.verse_25: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"
verse.verse_26: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!
verse.verse_27: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!
verse.verse_28: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one's right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).
verse.verse_29: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).
verse.verse_30: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
verse.verse_31: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.
verse.verse_32: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
verse.verse_33: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.
verse.verse_34: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut's household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-
verse.verse_35: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.
verse.verse_36: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.
verse.verse_37: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
verse.verse_38: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
verse.verse_39: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
verse.verse_40: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
verse.verse_41: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from Allah).
verse.verse_42: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.
verse.verse_43: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?
verse.verse_44: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?
verse.verse_45: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
verse.verse_46: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter.
verse.verse_47: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.
verse.verse_48: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"
verse.verse_49: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.
verse.verse_50: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.
verse.verse_51: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?
verse.verse_52: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):
verse.verse_53: Every matter, small and great, is on record.
verse.verse_54: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
verse.verse_55: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
